title: All O(1) Data Structure
goal: Solve All O(1) Data Structure: Maintain ordered frequency buckets and move each key only between neighboring counts after an increment or decrement.
strategy: Maintain ordered frequency buckets and move each key only between neighboring counts after an increment or decrement.
edgeCases: Keys disappear at zero count; empty buckets must be removed without breaking minimum and maximum lookup.
inputRules: A count update needs a nonempty key.
